title: Handles button clicks
summary: Use addEventListener to register a click event listener for the button. When the browser receives the click, it runs the function passed in as the second parameter.
tasks: Add click event monitoring to the #reserve button.

goal: After the user clicks to confirm the registration, the operation result will be fed back through the status text.
